decision.rationale: The representative array contains a pet without photoUrls. The field is required, but default initialization and nullable setter behavior conflict; no independent same-scenario presence assertion establishes intended output.

scope.tests_and_docs: Package-local test directories, README/API prose and linked DTO/service/serialization files only.

manual_fallback.notes: The representative response was parsed in full: array index 6 (id 22176) lacks photoUrls. Earlier members having the property do not establish intent. Pet initializes a list at :32, while PetData.createPet can set null at :121; no independent response obligation was found.

coverage_resolution: Manual handler and field review supplements the lexical scan.
